function.name: check_availability
function.description: Returns available 30-minute appointment slots for a given date. Call this when the patient wants to know what times are open, or before proposing a specific reschedule time.

date.description: Date to check in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. '2026-06-20').

provider.description: Optional provider name to filter by (e.g. 'Dr. Patel'). Omit to show availability across all providers.

function.name: get_appointment
function.description: Retrieves the current patient's upcoming scheduled appointments. Call this at the start of any scheduling conversation, or when the patient asks what appointment they have.

patient_id.description: The patient ID from the patient context.

function.name: reschedule_appointment
function.description: Moves an existing scheduled appointment to a new date and time. Only call this AFTER the patient has verbally confirmed the new time. The new_time should come from a slot returned by check_availability.

appointment_id.description: ID of the appointment to reschedule (from get_appointment).

new_time.description: New appointment start time in ISO 8601 format (e.g. '2026-06-20T10:00:00').

function.name: cancel_appointment
function.description: Cancels an existing scheduled appointment. Only call this AFTER the patient explicitly confirms they want to cancel. Do not call proactively.

appointment_id.description: ID of the appointment to cancel (from get_appointment).

function.name: escalate_to_human
function.description: Ends the AI session and transfers the patient to a human staff member. Use when: the patient is upset or frustrated, the request is outside your capabilities, intent remains unclear after one clarifying question, or the patient asks to speak with a person.

reason.description: Brief reason for escalation — logged for staff context (e.g. 'patient asking about billing', 'unclear intent after two turns').
